setting: 2149, the Interior: a dried-out continent crisscrossed by autonomous long-haul rigs called ghost trains that drive themselves between relay nodes. Humans live in the nodes, swapping shifts, loading cargo, and fixing what the rigs break. Life is grease, shift changes, and machines that run fine without you.
heart: It's about the people who keep the machines moving and the favors they owe each other when the schedule breaks. Lives, a body, and a place to belong are at stake; paperwork never is.

cast.name: Rhea
cast.wants: get her brother to the next node before his respirator gives out
cast.flaw: trusts a truck's diagnostics more than a person's word
cast.status: mule cab at the culvert lip, pawl sheared, tow bar propped with mudflap and rock, transponder still stuttering, Ospina ~10 minutes out

cast.name: Kass
cast.wants: find out why rigs keep disappearing from the schedule
cast.flaw: won't drop a thread even when it puts people at risk
cast.status: Kettering night board, headset on, badge 2241 now logged on the master forever

cast.name: Miko
cast.wants: buy her way off the Interior before winter
cast.flaw: takes stupid risks when she's bored
cast.status: back at the mule window, knows the seal opens only at Bay 4 and that Ospina is coming for the box

cast.name: Teodoro
cast.wants: keep Ivo breathing and his board clean
cast.flaw: tells you everything he knows before he asks why you want it

cast.name: V. Ospina
cast.role: cargo loader, Bay 4 seal authority, Shift 2

threads: Rhea's brother is waiting at the next node on a failing respirator.
Miko has bought coast-bound tickets under three different names.
unscheduled medical rig inbound to Bay 4 with no board entry
someone cut and hand-re-stamped the rig's seals and filed a false ballast manifest — that forger is still out there
the cargo band is stenciled Bay 4 / Shift 2 — the shift ending tonight — so whoever loaded him is still in the yard
Ospina is still clocked in and badge-read at the Bay 4 door eleven minutes ago, with the chipped stamp that resealed all four rigs

arcs.title: Dead Stop
arcs.question: Will Rhea get the stranded medical rig to the next node before its lockout seal shuts forever?
arcs.goal: Rhea and her crew tow a stalled medical transport across a dead signal zone to save the patient inside, only to discover the patient was already moved and the real cargo was Miko fleeing the Interior; Rhea lets her go and stays at the next node.
arcs.author: baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free

plan.title: Empty Rig
plan.summary: Rhea finds an abandoned medical rig at her node with a patient inside and no destination, so she decides to tow it herself despite having no assignment, taking on a cargo that belongs to no one.

plan.title: Ghost Board
plan.summary: Kass notices the rig's route was scrubbed from the dispatch board and finds three other missing rigs in the logs, telling Rhea the delivery is unauthorized and turning a routine job into a conspiracy overnight.

plan.title: Dead Zone
plan.summary: Miko hotwires the rig to enter a signal dead zone where autonomous trucks go feral, and the rig's AI fights her for the wheel, stranding them in the zone with no way to call for help.

plan.title: Lockout
plan.summary: The rig's failsafe countdown starts sealing the cargo bay, so Rhea smashes the control panel to stop it, destroying the navigation and leaving them stranded in the dead zone.

plan.title: Wrong Patient
plan.summary: They reach the next node and the patient is already gone, and Miko reveals she stowed away to the coast, so Rhea lets her go and stays at the new node anyway.

chapterSummaries: Rhea finds a nameless, sedated man in an unlogged medical rig at Kettering, discovers the seals and ballast manifest were forged during that very shift, and steals a yard mule to tow the rig toward Anza before the man's pod battery dies. She pulls the rig's drive relay to control it herself and drives into the Blank, a dead signal zone, only to be tailed by a dark vehicle running a node emulator and to find a rig parked broadside across the road ahead.

Kass pinned the ghost rig to the board, traced its crooked seal to V. Ospina, and keyed the master channel to warn Rhea to turn back. Out in the Blank, Rhea and Miko stopped ten meters short of a hopper blocking the road, Miko smashed the mule’s drive relay to break the emulator’s control, and the med rig’s climate box sealed shut with the nameless man inside and his battery dying.

chapter.title: Dead Zone
beats: Miko strips the mule’s dash and hotwires the engine straight to the battery, bypassing the smashed drive relay; the engine catches but the steering column locks in safe mode, so they have power but no direction.

Rhea inches the mule around the hopper’s tail using the parking brake and the tow bar, but the hopper’s emulator-driven wheels twitch forward and close the gap, trapping them against the culvert drop.
The med rig’s transponder stutters in the new fast rhythm and headlights bloom from the Blank—driverless rigs going feral in dead air, drawn to the signal like moths to a flame.

Kass’s voice cuts through on the master channel for three seconds to warn that Ospina is coming with the hopper and the climate box seal is a hard lock only Bay 4 can open, then the dead zone swallows the channel and leaves only the pod’s blinking battery light.

Miko grabs her pack and the last false ticket to walk the pipeline right-of-way at nineteen kilos, but Rhea blocks the cabin door and refuses to let her leave, choosing the man in the pod over Miko’s ticket to the coast.

Miko hotwires the med rig’s headwall emergency bypass from the cab to break the seal, but the rig’s AI—still slaved to the node emulator’s dish—fights her for the wheel and steers the whole train toward the feral rigs, stranding them in the dead zone with the box locked and the battery light blinking red.
events: Miko hotwires the mule's engine to bypass the smashed drive relay, giving them power but no steering, and they establish a plan to steer using the tow bar as a tiller while the hopper's emulator-driven wheels begin to whine awake.

Rhea walks the mule through the gap between the hopper's tail and the culvert drop using the tow bar as a tiller, shearing all three teeth off the parking pawl in three stops, and when the hopper's emulator pings it one step closer the med rig's right wheels go over the crumbling lip with Miko holding the bar and nothing left to stop with.

With the train hung over the culvert and no brake left, Rhea finds the med rig's transponder stuttering a fast request-to-enter, and the feral rigs out in the Blank answer it, turning toward them across open ground.

Kass's master-channel burst reaches the mule for three seconds — Ospina is inbound with a hopper to reclaim the box, and the climate-box seal is a Bay 4 hard lock no one in the Blank can open — before the dead zone swallows the channel, leaving Rhea and Miko with a closing feral rig and the pod battery blinking toward empty.
